geometry.authoring: Project-authored offline running-bond block generator; real top, bevel, side and source-ledge riser triangles
geometry.runtime: road-geometry.js, static bundled buffers; no runtime remeshing or new collisions

independentNavCheck.method: final top triangle interior barycentrics queried against unchanged nav.groundAt; safeGround only filters nonwalkable decoration

statistics.layout: single running-bond mother grid, no split bricks/no random omissions
statistics.topShading: one restrained average normal per whole slab; actual bevel and side normals retained

geometry.walkingHeightSource: Existing nav.groundAt after original fine surface provider; safeGround filters decorative nonwalkable foreground only
geometry.nonwalkableForeground: Original coarse H bilinear slope, with original fine cache where available; render-only decoration outside original safeGround, excluded from the independent walking-height audit

independentAudit.sampleReport: Integrated H35 evidence; this helper reads frozen runtime buffers and original nav independently
independentAudit.scope: Discrete final-triangle interior samples on original safeGround; not a mathematical proof of every point

standardGLB.engineColorMix: Standard GLB keeps original texture; runtime custom contrast mix is documented in its material extras

stoneTexture.origin: Unmodified byte copy of project-owned environment-033/handpainted-stone-atlas.webp; original H33 ImageGen edit of project-authored vector atlas
stoneTexture.UV: Four interior quiet-cell rectangles recorded in road-layout.json; old painted joints are not used as new physical joints

bedrock.origin: Unmodified copied H34 hand-authored/Blender-bevelled ledges; original editable source remains environment-034/hand-cut-bedrock.blend

lighting.stoneTop: One restrained average fixed-sun normal per complete block; actual physical bevel/side normals retained
lighting.lamps: H34 stone lantern shapes retained; warm pane, point light and flicker disabled

unchanged: Navigation legality, original cached H/R and fine heights
Original gate stairs and walking-route collision
privateReference: Private video informs the requested road/ground relationship only; no frames/audio embedded or copied into this asset directory
